workspace.bad_grand_master_sheet: That sheet cannot be the Grand Master: use an agent that is not the PC Operator and runs on every machine that is not excluded.
workspace.bad_state: The state of the campaign does not allow that now.
workspace.creation_failed: The campaign could not be created: GitHub or Mestre refused. Nothing was created.
workspace.fetch_failing: The mirror of the campaign {{workspace}} cannot fetch GitHub since {{since}}: {{error}}. The tables keep working locally.
workspace.install_apps: The campaign {{workspace}} needs the Apps of the Mestre in the repository. Open the link, choose the repository and click Install:
workspace.invalid_document: The verification file does not hold: check the format, the commands and the time. Nothing was confirmed.
workspace.invalid_repo: The repository must be as owner/name.
workspace.invalid_slug: The nickname does not hold. Suggestion: {{suggestion}}.
workspace.not_preparing: The campaign is past the session zero.
workspace.not_ready: The main clone of the campaign does not exist yet. Wait for the mirror stage.
workspace.preparing: A campaign that is preparing cannot be paused.
workspace.repo_taken: That repository is already the campaign {{slug}}.
workspace.unknown_sheet: That sheet does not exist or does not run an agent. Nothing was created.
workspace.verification_edited: The file {{file}} of the campaign {{workspace}} was changed outside the panel. The last confirmed version stays in force; to apply the change, confirm it on the campaigns screen.
workspace.versioning_pending: Pending question of the campaign {{workspace}}: should the .mestre/ folder be versioned in the project or stay local only? Until the answer it stays local only. The answer is given in the panel.
workspace.worktree_moved: The main clone of the campaign {{workspace}} no longer points at the Mestre mirror; the engine does not use it until someone checks. {{cause}}
